items.title: Bot can be steered to quote private repository files back into a public fork pull request
Fork contributor hides instructions in the diff to make the bot approve malicious code
Bot approval misleads humans into skipping review of attacker-controlled code
Anyone can run up unbounded LLM cost by opening or updating fork pull requests
Bot token can approve and merge, so one hijacked review becomes a repository compromise
Files in the repository poison every review for all future pull requests
